Tessa / team — short answers:
- W-8BEN-E: the signed form is fine as evidence for withholding/tax residency for the US-payee relationship. We should confirm the "chapter 3" status box the customer checked to make sure it matches our records. No additional attestation needed from Redwood.
- VAT / reverse charge: for the EU entity we need VAT registration number and a VAT invoice that either contains reverse-charge language or references the EU reverse-charge mechanism. Since AWS is the billing intermediary, there are two flows:
  a) AWS reissues the invoice to EdgeScale Ltd (preferred for bookkeeping) — requires a marketplace support case and Customer-provided VAT registration docs; could take 5–10 business days.
  b) Redwood issues a credit memo and two replacement invoices — feasible but will require us to coordinate settlement reconciliation with AWS once the credit is processed. Accounting will need the original AWS invoice ID and settlement batch info.

Recommend: Ask customer to provide VAT registration doc + confirmation of legal entity exact names. Open a marketplace support ticket in parallel (I can draft language). If AWS cannot reissue within their SLA, proceed with Redwood credit + reissue.
